## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tángmì *màntúluó yíguǐ* 曼荼羅儀軌 — a full maṇḍala manual — for the *Sahasrabhuja* cycle, organised around the **Potalaka assembly** (補陀落海會) of Avalokiteśvara and his five-section retinue. The colophon names **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) as the translator. The very long descriptive title is conventional in Tángmì *yíguǐ*: the editorial sub-title 但呪讚及作法宜視大儀軌內 ("for the spells, hymns, and ritual procedures consult the great manual") indicates the present text is the maṇḍala-iconography component to be paired with [KR6j0272](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0272) (the recitation-practice manual) and [KR6j0269](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0269) (the spell-text proper) as the third member of the Amoghavajra *Sahasrabhuja* *yíguǐ* triad.

**Abstract**

The text describes the full maṇḍala of the **Potalaka oceanic assembly** of Avalokiteśvara: the central deity (Sahasrabhuja-Avalokiteśvara), the four directional bodhisattvas, the five-section retinue (五部諸尊 — Buddha section, Vajra section, Ratna section, Padma section, Karma section), each deity's *praṇidhāna* / *bāla* (弘誓力), spatial position (方位), comportment (威儀), iconographic form and color (形色), and *samaya* / insignia (三摩耶幖幟). The explicit "drawing-out-boundless-meanings-from-one-method" rubric (計一法中出無量義) is the standard Tangmí formula for *kalpa*-derived ritual elaboration: from the single core dhāraṇī of [KR6j0260](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0260) the manual generates the full Esoteric maṇḍala of the *Sahasrabhuja* deity. The text is essential reading for understanding the Tángmì iconography of the *Sahasrabhuja* and the South-Indian *Pūrṇa-girí* / Potalaka maṇḍala tradition that Amoghavajra had brought back to China in 746.
